claim: stillness/eliana/teachings/throne_room/journal/bible_reader are registered in both the root and tab NavHosts, so the same screen behaves differently depending on entry path.
fix: Keep tab routes exclusively in MainScreen's tab NavHost and delete the duplicate registrations from MainActivity's root graph.

claim: In Reading mode, tap toggles tiers on ✦ verses but selects all other verses, and the selection bar offers no highlight/note/compare — the default mode cannot annotate scripture.
fix: Make tap=select uniform, move tier expansion to the ✦ glyph range, and add Highlight/Note (existing dialog) to the selection action bar.

claim: The Sacred Word card (verse + 3 essay fields) fills a full viewport, pushing Continue Reading, study path, and quick access below the fold or into visual subordination.
fix: Collapse Sacred Word to verse + one field with the rest behind Ascend, and promote Continue Reading to a full-width hero above it.

claim: The bottom bar highlights 'Journey' for journal/teachings/throne_room routes and uniquely disables restoreState for Journey, so the wayfinding lies and Journey loses its stack.
fix: Map routes to tabs the user actually navigated from and apply one restoreState rule to all tabs.

claim: Settings' Small/Normal/Large typography scale compounds with the reader's independent 12–28sp A−/A+ control, so font size behaves unpredictably.
fix: Unify on one font-size store — the reader control should write through to the same setting.

claim: The signature tier card, invite card, dialogs, and all of JourneyScreen still use translucent fills and elevated colored containers that the 2026-08 opaque/flat doctrine banned on Home.
fix: Apply the opaque-fill, zero-elevation doctrine to ElianaVerseTiers, StudyToolsComponents, and JourneyScreen.

claim: A 'Coming Soon' word-lookup stub with a TODO ships with a live registered route while the real Strong's/word-study feature exists in WordStudySheet.
fix: Delete the stub screen and route, or rebuild it as a search UI over the existing WordLookupMap data.

claim: Home's primary Ascend CTA can land on 'This study isn't available yet' when no cached Firestore insight exists for the verse.
fix: Route Ascend into the reader's Study mode at that verse, where offline depth (originals, morphology, chains) always exists.

claim: Journey's progress card ships two placeholder stats ('Prayers --', 'Sessions --') next to live ones.
fix: Wire prayers/sessions counts from their managers or remove the dead stats.

claim: ~800 LOC of unreferenced components (QuickAccessGrid, ElianaGreetingCard, DevotionalCard, BreathingElianaButton, VoiceCommandDialog, VersionSelectionComponents) remain from removed eras.
fix: Delete the dead files; git history preserves them.

claim: Justified body text produces visible word-spacing rivers on phone-width columns (visible in 01-home.png).
fix: Use TextAlign.Start for verse and card body text.

claim: MainDestination, ARCHITECTURE.md, README.md, and STATE.md describe a retired 4-tab/4-theme app; even the name FourThemeSystem is false (six themes ship).
fix: One documentation pass over the four files; rename the theme object when convenient.
